name: Final Approach 2 ~1st Priority~
original_name: ふぁいなる・あぷろーち2～1st priority～
source:
Makoto, a high school student, lost his parents a while ago, and he now lives at his mother's friend house. Just on the valentine's day, Anna, a popular idol, suddenly comes to his house and they get engaged. It seems Anna is tricked to marry Makoto. Though they object, they are forced to live together. However, his younger sister comes back abroad as well to live with them...

[From Himeyashop]
translation:
高中生真失去雙親已有一段日子，如今寄住在母親的朋友家中。就在情人節當天，人氣偶像安娜突然來到他家，兩人還訂下了婚約。看來，安娜是遭人欺騙才要嫁給真。儘管雙方都表示反對，他們還是被迫住在一起。然而，真的妹妹也從國外回來，與他們住到了一起……

[摘自Himeyashop]
